ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Will you look down?' in Surah As-Saff?
ai.summary: This narration captures the Imam (عليه السلام) posing the rhetorical question 'Will you look down?' to elucidate the concept of divine surveillance and the spiritual vigilance required of believers. It serves as a practical commentary on the Quranic verse in Surah As-Saff, emphasizing that just as soldiers stand in ranks, believers must maintain conscious awareness of Allah's observation of their deeds and their collective standing.
